method: For each log, parse only the pytest short test summary section beginning at “short test summary info”; collect exact FAILED and ERROR node IDs and de-duplicate by (status,nodeid). Compare candidate status/node IDs against the union of all eight baseline logs, ignoring shard assignment. Each log’s pytest terminal summary is retained verbatim and numeric totals are reconciled against extracted IDs. Baseline pass observations for candidate-only IDs are corroborated from progress/pass lines where available.
